rationale: The incident evidence clearly indicates a failure due to an invalid port configuration in the 'shippingservice' deployment. The container log (E-0B1AEC308882) explicitly states: 'failed to listen: listen tcp: lookup tcp/invalid-port: unknown port', which directly points to a misconfigured port in the deployment. This misconfiguration is the root cause of the CrashLoopBackOff (E-33B877DACB01), readiness probe failure (E-89013BE9E81A), and the UnavailableReplicas status (E-36B74D80A669, E-6A23E4507F6B). The baseline configuration (BASE-LIVE-1f2252754dfd) is known to be healthy, as confirmed by the health_evidence and the template_sha256 hash. Rolling back to this baseline will restore the correct configuration and resolve the issue.
